GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

6. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

16. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
